_note: Stars with known planets (confirmed planets in the NASA Exoplanet Archive), one row per host. ra/dec in degrees (ICRS) at 'epoch'; pmra = mu_alpha*cos(dec) and pmdec in mas/yr; n = number of known planets in the system; plx (mas) and dist_pc from the archive (they disagree for a few hosts without Gaia ids, e.g. GJ 273 and GJ 411: use plx for nearby stars). epoch: 2015.5 for hosts with a Gaia DR2 id (their archive position is the Gaia DR2 one), else about 2000.0. Move a position with its proper motion before matching it to an observation. Built by pipeline/exoplanet_hosts.py.
source: NASA Exoplanet Archive, Planetary Systems Composite Parameters table (pscomppars)
overview_note: Replace {host} with the URL-encoded host name (encodeURIComponent).
